system.one_liner: A benchmark that audits how much privacy differentially private LLM adaptations really give, using membership inference and canary extraction while the adaptation data shifts from overlapping to out-of-distribution.

content.variant_note: data sources feed one LLM box that an outside auditor queries before a membership-inference verdict
content.argues: A DP-adapted LLM should be audited from outside by an auditor who queries it, with private adaptation data varied from overlapping to in-distribution, out-of-distribution and canary.
content.subject: Pretraining data and four private adaptation sets feeding a DP-adapted LLM that an auditor queries before MIA verdict cards.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a threat-model or audit setup as an actor loop: colour-coded data cylinders feed the model with a training mark, and an outside auditor icon trades dotted Query and dashed Answer arrows before verdict signs.
lessons.suits: Evaluation or threat-model setups where a model, several data sources and an external evaluator interact, and one factor such as data distribution is varied.

evidence: Figure 1: Setup for Privacy Auditing of private LLM Adaptations.
A general overview of privacy auditing for adapted LLMs is provided in Figure 1.

summary: The paper benchmarks how much privacy differentially private adaptations of LLMs actually give, using robust membership inference and canary extraction while the adaptation data moves from exact overlap with pretraining data to in-distribution and out-of-distribution. Figure 1 is the setup diagram. A pretrained dataset (cylinder) trains the LLM along a flame-marked arrow. Four colour-coded cylinders named Overlap, IID, OOD and Canary, grouped as Private adaptation datasets, feed the Adaptation box inside the LLM container through an arrow labelled (ε, δ)-DP. On the right an Auditor, drawn as a judge, sends dotted Query arrows and receives dashed Answer arrows, then passes the outcome to an MIA box with green-check and red-cross signs. A small single-column figure built from clip-art, rounded outlined boxes and dotted tinted regions.
summary_zh: 该论文评测差分隐私适配的大模型实际保护了多少隐私。图1为审计设置：预训练数据集与Overlap、IID、OOD、Canary四类私有适配数据喂入LLM，右侧法官形象的审计者与模型交换Query/Answer，再由MIA给出判定。
notes: Prior kinds kept (actor-interaction, stage-pipeline). Flames sit on the data arrows (fire half only, no snowflake), so state_marker is other. The meaning of the check and cross signs (member / non-member) and of the flames is read from convention, not from the text. The Overlap cylinder shares the blue of the pretrained cylinder top, which may be deliberate. The dotted regions are pattern fills. The preview crop cuts the caption.
